Leah: Heads up — I noticed ~40 candidates lost their assigned interviewers after I ran a bulk tag update last night. This happened in both stage and prod.
Devon: Which bulk update was that? the 'market-fit' tag batch?
Leah: @Devon yes. I used Candidates > Bulk actions > Apply tags. Filtered by created_at and applied tags: market-fit, inbound. After that the interviewer field for a bunch of rows is blank.
Matt: Could be a race where the bulk edit removed and re-added tag rows and the candidate_assignees join got temporarily dropped. Any DB errors in logs?
Sam: I pulled the ops logs. There's a deadlock on candidate_assignees around 2024-11-12T19:05:02Z. Snippet: ```ERROR: deadlock detected on table candidate_assignees at txn 0x7f3b4c; DETAIL: Process 12345 waits for ShareLock; Process 12346 waits for ExclusiveLock```
RecruitingBot: Automated — incident created INC-2024-324, assigned to @Matt.
Devon: We need a rollback or quick restore — folks have interviews tomorrow morning.
Matt: We might be able to replay audit events to rebuild assignees. Leah, can you export the candidate IDs from the bulk action? If not, I have a query to find affected candidates in the audit table: ```SELECT candidate_id FROM audit_events WHERE event_type='candidate.update' AND changed_fields @> '{"tags"}' AND created_at BETWEEN '2024-11-12 18:50:00' AND '2024-11-12 19:10:00';```
Leah: Exporting now, sending CSV to the thread.
Devon: Also noticed interviewer prep packets didn't attach to scheduled slots after the update. That might be the same root cause — our prep-generator looks at candidate.tags to select templates.
Sam: Correct. Prep generator will skip if tag set is empty. I'll plan to re-run generation for the affected candidate IDs once assignees are back.
Leah: Proposed plan: 1) Matt replays audit to restore assignees (dry-run first), 2) Sam re-triggers prep-gen for IDs in the CSV, 3) I'll notify impacted interviewers/candidates and schedule confirmations. Sound good?
Matt: Running dry-run now, will post output. If it matches CSV we'll run the real one. Dry-run shows 38 candidate_assignee restores.
Devon: Please @mention me on the real run. Also can we add a guard to the bulk edit UI that warns if interviewer assignments or assignee rows will be touched?
Leah: Adding that to the postmortem: UI confirmation + ensure tag updates are atomic w.r.t assignees.
Sam: Prep-gen re-trigger queued. We hit a brief rate-limit so ETA ~10m to finish.
Matt: Actual replay completed — restored 38 assignees. Migration tag: restore-20241112-01.
Leah: Thanks all. I'll send calendar nudges and follow up with a short retro + action items (UX guard, atomic update, monitor alert for candidate_assignee deadlocks). Marking as resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
